D: A stolen diamond, a crooked boxing promoter and a dog all collide in London's underworld.
P: Serve the mains when the dog swallows the squeaky toy.
S: Small minced beef pies in shortcrust with a puff lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with mash and a parsley liquor of stock, butter, flour and lots of parsley.
Aged cheddar, red Leicester and a crumbly Wensleydale cut into sharp little diamond shapes, with crackers and pickled onions.
the caravans where the bare-knuckle fighters live
Thin pork sausages grilled until sticky, glazed with honey and wholegrain mustard, served on toothpicks.
M: the promoter's office and its kettle
Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, black pudding, mushrooms and grilled tomato with buttered toast.
the New York diamond dealer who hates London
Sirloin seared hard, pulled at 54C, rested, with a baked potato and creamed spinach, the way Avi would order back home.
W: Biscuit base, thick caramel and sliced bananas under a mountain of cream and grated chocolate.
K: the London pub where the deals happen
English ale poured at cellar temperature into a pint glass, a bowl of salted peanuts on the bar.

s.how: Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g Red Leicester and 150g Wensleydale into sharp little diamond shapes. Arrange on a board with crackers and pickled onions. Don't swallow any of the diamonds.

s.note: the caravans where the bare-knuckle fighters live
s.how: Grill 500g chipolatas until browned. Toss in a hot pan with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard until sticky. Spear on toothpicks and serve hot. Do you like dags?

m.note: the promoter's office and its kettle
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon and 4 pork sausages. Fry 4 eggs, 4 slices black pudding and 200g mushrooms. Warm a tin of baked beans and grill 2 halved tomatoes. Serve with buttered toast.

w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits mixed with 120g melted butter into a pie dish and chill. Spread with 380g tinned caramel, layer 3 sliced bananas, top with 300ml whipped cream and grated chocolate.

d.note: the London pub where the deals happen
d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour so they're cool, not cold. Pour into pint glasses and put a bowl of 150g salted peanuts on the bar.
